events.title: Front brake pops in the rain
events.summary: I was going down a hill near Kempten in the rain, already wet, when my front brake popped. When I looked down I was relieved to see it was only the little mounting screw that had slipped, and I stopped to fix it.

events.title: Tired, wet, thinking of quitting
events.summary: Near Kempten I was exhausted, soaked by rain, with no place to stay and no idea where I was going. For a moment I thought about giving up the whole trip and taking a year off work to build fun little toys instead.
events.quote: i was contemplating just not doing this whole thing
